title: Service-Induced Congestion in Memory-Constrained LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2606.15555v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In large language model (LLM) serving, each request accumulates persistent graphics processing unit (GPU) memory during service as its key-value cache grows with every generated token. Under high concurrency, aggregate memory usage therefore increases endogenously over time: the service process itself creates future capacity pressure. When memory capacity is exceeded, systems evict active requests, discarding cached state and restarting them later, which wastes computation and reduces throughput. We develop a discrete-time dynamical model of memory-constrained LLM inference that captures admission, memory growth, and eviction under continuous batching. In the saturated-input regime, the system admits both eviction-free fixed points and limit cycles with evictions. For homogeneous workloads, we show that the eviction-free equilibrium is unstable and that, except for a Lebesgue-measure-zero exact-capture set, the system converges

translated_title: 内存受限大语言模型服务中的服务诱导型拥塞
translated_abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）服务中，每个请求在服务过程中会持续占用GPU显存，因为其键值缓存会随着每个生成令牌而不断增长。在高并发情况下，总体内存使用量因此会随时间内生地增长：服务过程本身会制造未来的容量压力。当超出内存容量时，系统会驱逐活跃请求，丢弃已缓存的状态并在之后重新启动它们，这会浪费计算资源并降低吞吐量。我们建立了一个内存受限LLM推理的离散时间动力学模型，用以刻画连续批处理下的请求准入、内存增长与驱逐行为。在饱和输入状态下，系统既存在无驱逐的不动点，也存在带驱逐的极限环。对于同质工作负载，我们证明无驱逐平衡态是不稳定的，并且除了一个勒贝格测度为零的精确捕获集合之外，系统均收敛于……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将内存受限的LLM服务建模为离散时间动力学系统，揭示了服务过程本身会内生地累积显存压力并引发请求驱逐，并证明了在同质负载下无驱逐平衡态不稳定，系统通常会收敛到带驱逐的极限环。
en_tdlr: This paper models memory-constrained LLM serving as a discrete-time dynamical system, revealing that the serving process itself endogenously accumulates GPU memory pressure causing request evictions, and proves that the eviction-free equilibrium is unstable under homogeneous workloads, with the system typically converging to limit cycles with evictions.
